description: Ghent University provides data for ALPHEUS deliverable 3.6 on dry-test validation of a contra-rotating reversible pump-turbine control architecture. The release includes emulation data, control lookup tables, small-scale test outputs, drivetrain friction tests and frequency-containment-reserve validation results. MATLAB and Excel formats are stated. A pump-mode video is described as a presentation component of the same test bundle. Coverage: No complete measurement interval or evaluation extent is stated in the reviewed source. Access: public native metadata describes the release and its formats. Licence: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The native title states TRL4; this is a provider-reported deliverable label, not independent maturity verification. The source separates control tests from related fluid-dynamics experiments. Test bodies and reserve-provision performance were not examined. Control emulation and the tests support calibration of pump-turbine control simulations.
